info.title: EXCLURAD eta kinematics at W=2.0, Q2=3.0

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Run eta at W = 2.0, Q2 = 3.0 with a 2.2 GeV beam.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested beam-energy kinematics against the eta threshold and lookup-table coverage, then generate a compatible EXCLURAD input only if the point is viable.

parts.text: The requested electron kinematics are accessible at 2.2 GeV. EXCLURAD additionally requires the hadronic center-of-mass angle and azimuth, which were not specified; I will generate a clearly flagged nominal input at `cos(theta*) = 0` and `phi = 0 deg`, using the validated full O(alpha) mode.

parts.text: Preflight rejects the requested kinematics: producing \(W=2.0\) at \(Q^2=3.0\) requires a 3.261 GeV energy transfer, exceeding the 2.2 GeV beam. I will record a refusal without creating an EXCLURAD input.

*** End Patch
